units: pixels and seconds only; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (phase-correlation shift of the static upper-wall region vs frame 0 < 0.1 px in every frame; see camera_check.json)

intrinsics_from_benchmark_convention.note: lab convention 0.5959 x width; not measured here

camera.timing_anomaly: no duplicated frames; frame 35->36 has about 2x the normal inter-frame change and the ball moves about 2x its neighbouring steps, so one camera frame was probably dropped between frames 35 and 36

perspective_cues.note: approximate, read off a 50 px grid at frame 0; camera looks slightly down at the floor; the horizon is above the back-wall base. Wide lens: straight edges near the image border look slightly curved

exercise_ball.description: large dark grey/purple-blue inflatable exercise (gym) ball, the only big grey sphere; starts on the floor in front of the crouching person, just left of the blue bin
exercise_ball.reference_point: visible centre = centre of the fitted circle (frames 0-31: circle fitted to the full edge; 32-44: circle fitted to the upper rim, because the bottom is cut off by the frame and merges with the shadow)
exercise_ball.motion_summary: at rest (hands on it, slight rocking of +-3 px) frames 0-18; pushed and rolls toward the camera and to the left, leaving through the lower-left image corner; growing apparent size = approaching the camera

person.description: one person in dark (black) clothes, face blurred to a grey patch, crouching behind the ball and to the left of the blue bin; pushes the ball, then throws the arms up and stays crouched
person.reference_point: centroid of the dark-clothing/hair mask (bare arms/hands not included)
person.note: crouching the whole clip; no standing height visible. Lower body hidden behind the ball in frames 0-~21. Crouched bbox height 183-203 px (frames 22-48), head top y 345-363, centroid x moves from ~655 to ~624 (shifts left while reaching to the floor)

basketball.description: orange basketball on the floor, lower centre-right of the image
basketball.note: bottom edge close to the image bottom; identical at frames 0, 24, 47

recycling_bin.description: blue rectangular recycling bin with yellow pattern and white recycle logo, right of the person
recycling_bin.note: front face seen roughly head-on; partly occluded (left edge) by the person's arm/ball in frames 0-21

shoe.description: single white sneaker with black stripes lying on the floor, lower left
shoe.visible_frames: 0-48, occluded by the passing ball in about frames 36-41
shoe.axis_angle_deg: about 40-45 (toe at lower left, heel at upper right)

tripod_left.description: black camera tripod in the back-left corner (head near x 475, y 180)

tripod_right.description: black camera tripod near the right wall (head near x 975, y 120)
tripod_right.height_px_approx: 465 (head top to the lowest clear foot y 583); +-15

tv_screen.description: black wall-mounted TV/monitor on the back wall, top centre

room.description: grey padded acoustic wall panels, grey striped carpet, red cable on the floor along the left wall base

events.event: ball at rest under the person's hands (slight rocking, cx 614-621 px)
push / ball starts rolling (centre starts moving left-down)
release: hands leave the ball, arms thrown up
ball rolls toward the camera and left; direction roughly constant (image direction down-left, steepening)
ball bottom first touches the lower image border
ball passes in front of the shoe (occludes it; shoe does not move)
ball last visible (small cap at the lower-left corner)
person stays crouched, hands to the floor

files.tracks/exercise_ball_raw.csv: raw edge-circle fits for all frames 0-44 (good only for 0-31)
files.static_measure.json: colour-mask measurements of basketball, bin, shoe at frames 0, 24, 47
files.camera_check.json: per-frame mean abs difference and background shift
